desc: Is Paper Mario 64's Jr. Troopa fair in the story? His first fight in the plaza at the level the story gives (Mario level 1, 10 HP, Goombella), with NORMAL damage (no god mode) and a plain strategy: the auto battler's attacks with no action commands and no guards (TTYD_AUTO_BATTLE_ASSIST=0) and no items (TTYD_AUTO_BATTLE_ITEMS=-1). He must lose: the win, Goombario joining; his hits 1-2 a time
